name: design-coach
description: How a page this coach publishes should look, made checkable: text that never leaves its box, every diagram in a zoomable wrapper, the project's own fonts and palette when it has them and IBM Plex on a sea-to-lime palette only as the fallback, WCAG contrast in both themes. Ships one skill, one zero-dependency lint, and the one hook outside ai-coach-core — a nudge that loads the skill after a native artifact skill does, and a lint that asks before a failing page is published. Touches neither memory nor the engine.
